descriptionHtml: Teams registered for IEEEXtreme 13.0 from University of Peradeniya participated for the competition at the computer lab. They were provided with necessary facilities during the competition. Nine teams were participated and three of the teams were able to secure second, fifth and eighth places in the Sri Lankan score board. Among them one team was within the first hundred over the world!.
